warnings.desc: DAMAGING WINDS averaging 80 to 90 km/h are possible across alpine above 1900 metres from Tuesday afternoon, peaking late on Tuesday evening. Winds are forecast to ease below warning thresholds before dawn on Wednesday. Locations which may be affected include Thredbo Top Station.

warnings.title: Severe Weather Warning for North East, West and South Gippsland, East Gippsland
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WIND GUSTS of up to 100 km/h are possible about the alpine ranges from Tuesday afternoon, peaking late on Tuesday evening. Winds are forecast to ease below warning thresholds before dawn on Wednesday. Locations which may be affected include Falls Creek, Mt Hotham and Mt Buller.

warnings.title: Severe Weather Warning for North East, East Coast, Upper Derwent Valley, South East, Western
warnings.desc: DAMAGING WIND GUSTS of about 100 km/h are possible over elevated parts of southern and eastern Tasmania from late Tuesday morning, peaking during Tuesday afternoon. Winds are forecast to ease below warning thresholds on Tuesday evening. Locations which may be affected include Strathgordon.
